run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_warmup: test time_func warmup runs 5 iterations before measuring performance of a function
create_benchmark_with_time_func: create a benchmark using time_func with a custom number of iterations and name
review_time_func_timing: review time_func which uses perf_counter to measure average execution time in milliseconds
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func that benchmarks a function with warmup and reports per-iteration time
